item.title: 🔵 Hijacked Hotel Wi-Fi Pushes Fake Updates to Deliver Surveillance Malware
item.description:
Why this matters: Nation-state threat actor — elevated persistence and lateral movement risk.
A fake browser update served over hijacked hotel Wi-Fi has been used to deliver CornFlake, a remote access trojan (RAT) that can capture webcam images, microphone audio, and keystrokes, Microsoft said in its latest report. item.title: 🔵 Suspected Chinese-Speaking Hackers Target Central Asian Governments With OctLurk and SilkLurk
item.description:
Why this matters: Could impact sign-ins/MFA/Conditional Access — watch for login issues.
A Chinese-speaking threat actor is suspected to be behind a fresh wave of cyber attacks targeting government organizations mainly located in Central Asia, including Afghanistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, and the Syrian Arab Republic, since January 2025.
